text:
Yara: Quick kickoff  Sapphire Cloud marketplace listing + integration launch set for July 14. Main asks: inbound lead routing (no double-touch), co-branded nurture, benchmark blurb for launch post, and dev sandbox CTA. Who wants what?
Owen: I can own tagging + routing. Proposal: canonical params utm_source=sapphire_marketplace, utm_campaign=SAPPH-0714, and add hidden field partner=sapphire. Use HubSpot + SFDC for flows; Segment optional for analytics events.
Liam: For partner handoff: prefer webhook for instant routing when partner DPA signed. Otherwise nightly SFTP w/ PGP. Partner also asked for a separate CSV for downloads in case they want to seed their ops system.
Nia: Landing form fields: email, first_name, last_name, company, role, region, sandbox_interest (radio: yes/no), partner_share (checkbox). partner_share defaults to unchecked. Add captcha and raster for bot protection.
Yara: Important: avoid double-touch. Routing rule idea: first_touch=marketplace should create a contact with source_priority=partner_marketplace. If that contact later converts via paid ad, we keep partner as first_touch attribution but mark conversion_channel=ads. Partner crediting rules live in the tracking doc.
Owen: Routing matrix proposal (short):
- partner_share=true AND sandbox_interest=yes -> push to Partner SDR queue (real-time webhook if DPA else nightly CSV)
- lead_score >= 65 OR enterprise_domain -> Redwood AE -> email + slack notify partner (no immediate handoff)
- sandbox_interest=no and partner_share=unchecked -> co-branded nurture list (7-email cadence)
- webinar_registered + attended -> add +20 to lead_score and re-evaluate routing
Liam: CSV nightly header sample (partner drop):
```
email,first_name,last_name,company,region,role,sandbox_interest,partner_share,utm_source,utm_campaign,hs_contact_id,sfdc_contact_id,lead_score,first_touch_channel
```
Nia: Add a small field `consent_timestamp` to prove opt-in in case partner audits. Also, we should include `sandbox_tier` for devs who request access (free vs enterprise sandbox).
Yara: For the benchmark narrative: keep it short and reproducible. Two scenarios: baseline (single-node inference) vs Redwood+Sapphire routed (multi-node batching + KV cache). Method: same 50 prompts, 10 warmups, report median p50/p95 and $/1000 tokens. Include link to reproducible script and hardware note. Liam/Nia, can you draft the 3-paragraph blurb?
Liam: I'll draft the methodology paragraph and include a tiny CSV of numbers. Nia: I'll write the customer-facing blurb and CTA.
Owen: Ads + landing CTAs: primary CTA = "Try Sapphire Sandbox" (dev button), secondary = "Register for launch webinar" (capture emails), tertiary = "Request enterprise POC". For ads A/B test headlines: A) "Reduce inference cost with Redwood + Sapphire" B) "Ship integrated LLM features with Sapphire + Redwood". We'll split by channel.
Nia: UX note: sandbox signup should return a short API key provisioning flow and a waiver screen about token quotas. Keys should expire in 30 days by default. Partner asked to receive sandbox requests in a separate CSV for provisioning.
Yara: Legal check: partner_share checkbox wording must match legal-approved copy. Owen, can you put the exact copy in the tracking doc so we can reuse for all forms?
Owen: Yup. I'll paste legal-approved copy and add the consent_timestamp requirement. Also adding a sample webhook payload in the spec doc.
Liam: On dedupe: dedupe by email + company + campaign_code. If duplicate found, update contact with highest priority source but keep original first_touch.
Nia: For co-branded nurture, propose a cohorted drip: Devs get 7 technical emails (SDKs, sandbox how-to), Product folks get 5 product-use-case emails, Enterprise gets AE outreach. Use dynamic content in HubSpot to swap CTAs.
Yara: Assignments: Owen = HubSpot workflows + webhook spec + legal copy (due 6/18), Liam = benchmark numbers + reproducible csv + methodology (due 6/20), Nia = landing + sandbox flow + CTAs + blog blurb (due 6/22). I'll own partner comms and combined checklist.
sam-bot: Event created: "Sapphire launch ops sync" 6/21 11:00am PT. Link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/meet/sapphire-launch-sync
Owen: One more: partner asked for real-time enrichment fields they care about (role, sandbox_tier, lead_score). We'll include those in webhook payload and nightly CSV. Also encrypt webhook payloads using HMAC header.
Liam: For the blog micro-benchmark screenshot, I'll generate a tiny chart with p50/p95 and $/1k tokens. Nia: please ensure the blog includes a short reproducibility checklist and a link to the sandbox.
Yara: Great. Drop workflow screenshots, sample nightly CSV, and the sandbox provisioning CSV into the tracking folder before the 6/21 sync. Tracking doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/marketing/sapphire-launch-tracking. Thanks team :sparkles:
